name: drop_vase
prompt: Redesign the failed vase scene as ONE much clearer funny mascot sticker. Reference image identifies exact cat and art style: ivory cream plump cat, oversized head, thick dark forest green outlines, signature green roof-shaped student cap with central tab, red band, round gold badge, curled tail. Preserve character and clean flat sticker style. NEW COMPOSITION: cat sitting on the LEFT, shown in three-quarter view looking RIGHT, with a sly innocently satisfied expression. Its right forepaw is extended and visibly touches the SIDE of a small coral flower vase at the right, pushing it away. The vase is tilted strongly 45 degrees to the RIGHT, balanced precariously on its bottom edge, with a small single flower tipping with it. Two small curved movement marks make the outward tipping unmistakable. Other forepaw rests on cat's belly. Clear separation and clean contact point between paw and vase; the vase does NOT float behind the cat or intersect its body. Cat and vase sit at the same implied baseline without drawing a ground. SIMPLE silhouette: ONLY one cat, one vase and one flower. Remove ALL shelf, furniture, blue drops and extra scene elements. No shards. Transparent background, no ground plane, no shadow, no tile, no border, no lettering. Whole composition centered in square with generous transparent margins, nothing cropped. Funny 'I absolutely meant to do that' feline mischief, readable at small size.

name: tiny_box
prompt: Precise local sticker repair. Preserve this exact cat-in-too-small-cardboard-box illustration: SAME green student cap red band gold badge, ivory cat, contented closed eyes, little smile, both FRONT paws resting over top FRONT rim, hooked tail emerging from the OPEN TOP behind the cat, same cardboard color and open flaps, same thick forest green outlines and flat style. FIX ONLY THE IMPOSSIBLE HIND FOOT protruding through the lower RIGHT cardboard side. Remove that entire exposed hind foot and pink paw pads. Reconstruct a continuous intact cardboard SIDE WALL and bottom corner where it was. Both hind legs must be fully hidden INSIDE the box, none visible outside. No hole in box, no torn cardboard, no replacement limb. The tail must clearly emerge from the open top, not from side wall. Keep overall composition proportions and all other details unchanged. Full illustration centered in square with transparent margins all around. True transparent background, no border, text, ground or shadow.
